PLAN "12-Week Strength Programme Phased for Menstrual Cycle"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with cycle-aware periodization"

PHASES
  PHASE "Cycle 1" (Weeks 1-4):
    SUMMARY:
      "Weeks 1-2: Strength focus (moderate intensity), aerobic base, HIIT, and plyometric/power day. 
       Week 3: Deload for menstruation (lower intensity, no HIIT, low-impact plyometrics).
       Week 4: Return to moderate intensity, full training week."
  PHASE "Cycle 2" (Weeks 5-8):
    SUMMARY:
      "Weeks 5-6: Strength focus (high intensity, lower rep, higher RPE), aerobic base, HIIT, and higher intensity plyometric/power day.
       Week 7: Deload for menstruation (lower intensity, no HIIT, low-impact plyometrics).
       Week 8: Return to high intensity, full training week."
  PHASE "Cycle 3" (Weeks 9-12):
    SUMMARY:
      "Weeks 9-10: Strength focus (high intensity, moderate rep, higher RPE), aerobic base, HIIT, and plyometric/power day.
       Week 11: Deload for menstruation (lower intensity, no HIIT, low-impact plyometrics).
       Week 12: Return to high intensity, full training week, culminating in 1RM testing for squat, bench press, and deadlift."

NUTRITION
  PERIOD "Menstruation (Days 1-3)":
    calories: maintenance
    protein: 1.6g/kg
    carbs: moderate
    fat: moderate
    hydration: 2.5L/day minimum
    notes: "Increase magnesium-rich foods (leafy greens, nuts, seeds, legumes), omega-3 sources (fatty fish, chia, flax), and anti-inflammatory foods (berries, turmeric, ginger). Prioritize iron-rich foods (red meat, lentils, spinach) and vitamin C for absorption. Small, frequent meals if appetite is low. Limit caffeine and salty foods."
  PERIOD "Menstruation (Days 4-7)":
    calories: maintenance
    protein: 1.6g/kg
    carbs: moderate
    fat: moderate
    hydration: 2.5L/day minimum
    notes: "Continue iron and magnesium focus. Gradually return to normal meal size and frequency. Emphasize whole grains, fruits, and vegetables."
  PERIOD "Follicular (Days 8-14)":
    calories: slight surplus (+5-10%)
    protein: 1.6g/kg
    carbs: moderate-high
    fat: moderate
    hydration: 2.5L/day minimum
    notes: "Support higher training intensity with complex carbs (rice, oats, potatoes, fruit). Maintain iron and magnesium intake. Include lean proteins and healthy fats."
  PERIOD "Ovulation (Days 15-16)":
    calories: maintenance
    protein: 1.6g/kg
    carbs: moderate-high
    fat: moderate
    hydration: 2.5L/day minimum
    notes: "Continue complex carbs and lean protein. Ensure adequate hydration. Include anti-inflammatory foods."
  PERIOD "Luteal (Days 17-28)":
    calories: maintenance or slight surplus (+5%)
    protein: 1.8g/kg
    carbs: moderate
    fat: moderate-high
    hydration: 2.5L/day minimum
    notes: "Increase magnesium and B6-rich foods (bananas, chickpeas, salmon) to help with PMS symptoms. Prioritize fiber (vegetables, whole grains) to support digestion. Manage cravings with healthy snacks (nuts, yogurt, fruit). Reduce added sugars and processed foods. Maintain iron intake in preparation for next cycle."
